tapNote: tap portrait = open character sheet. Two hand buttons under the bars show the equipped item icon (main hand left, off hand right), 31x31 px = 45x45pt on iPhone 15; tap to use, dim while recovering. Min tap target 31px = 45pt (44pt minimum). Wren has an oil gauge row (oilBar) between her mana bar and her hand buttons; see art/ui/oil/oil_gauge.json.
note: scale canvas to screen width; fill leftover height with stone_strip_tile.png tiled vertically (below panel). View renders at 270x380, horizon y 190.

inventory_screen.slotsFormat: slots = [x0,y0,x1,y1] (same format as before and as paperdoll; x1/y1 exclusive); slotRects = the same as [x,y,w,h]. 12 slots, row-major, index 0-11. The old 40-slot grid is gone, no locked slots.
inventory_screen.iconRule: item icons are the existing 24x24 icons (ui/items/items.json), centred at 1x (slot x+8, y+8), never scaled

stackCountRule.position: right-aligned: text x = rightX - (digits*6 - 1), y = glyphTop (top of the 5x9 glyph box). rightX is exclusive: last lit column = rightX-1 (slot x+35), shadow column = rightX; digit rows y+29..35, shadow row y+36
stackCountRule.show: only when the slot holds 2 or more; display capped at 5 (the stack limit for potions, oil flasks, keys)

selectedGlow.rule: tap an item: its slot frame swaps to slot_40_selected.png (static warm orange frame, no pulsing or flicker); icon stays full colour at x+8,y+8. One selection at a time; tap it again or tap close to deselect. While selected, the desc box shows the item and hintLine shows bag.pick_hero.

inventory_screen.note: 12-slot bag (levels/actions.json progression.bag). Tap an item to select (selectedGlow), then tap a hero, slot, or the view (e.g. a door) to use it; long-press for its description in the desc box

hintRule.text: story/ui_text.json bag.pick_hero ("Tap a hero." / el "Πάτα έναν ήρωα."), shown only while an item is selected
hintRule.align: left; y = glyph-box top (390 = desc y + 50)
hintRule.descLinesNote: item name (#ffbe5a) on line 1, description and effect (#d8ccb0) on lines 2-4

closeIcon.rule: centred in the close rect at 1x, never scaled; pressed: well_pressed 26x26 (button_pressed_9slice) + icon 1 px lower

inventory_screen.paperdollIconRule: equipped item icon (24x24) centred at 1x in the slot: x = x0 + 3, y = y0 + 3 (slots are drawn inclusive, 31x31 px incl. the bronze outline)

panelIcons.rule: Icons are drawn by code, centred in their rect at 1x, NEVER scaled (1 art px = 1 canvas px; positions are integer). panel_585.png bakes only the raised stone plates of these buttons, no icons. Finger down: draw the pressed plate over the rect, then the icon 1 px lower; on release redraw the normal plate (well_28.png / well_60x28.png) + icon. Positions below are in 270x585 space.

count.rule: right-align: text x = rect.x + 25 - (digits*6 - 1), y = rect.y + 18 (top of the 5x9 glyph box; digits use rows 0-6, shadow lands on the plate bevel). Caps at 99; 2-digit counts overlap the flask by a few px but stay legible thanks to the shadow (suggest capping the display at 9 if counts stay small). Pressed: +1 px down with the icon. At 0 show the _empty icon and "0" in colourEmpty.

right-align: text x = rect.x + 25 - (digits*6 - 1), y = rect.y + 18 (top of the 5x9 glyph box; digits use rows 0-6, shadow lands on the plate bevel). Caps at 99; 2-digit counts overlap the flask by a few px but stay legible thanks to the shadow (suggest capping the display at 9 if counts stay small). Pressed: +1 px down with the icon. At 0 show the _empty icon and "0" in colourEmpty.

panelIcons.padNote: the 6 movement pad icons ARE baked into panel_585.png; for their pressed look draw well_pressed_28.png + the pad icon 1 px lower (centred).
panelIcons.potionNote: the old potion bottle icons (ui/items/icon_potion_*.png, 24x24, bottle 12x21) fit the plate but the bottle body runs into the bottom-right count corner, so the panel uses the 20x20 _btn versions (flask kept to the left 15 columns). Bag/floor icons stay as they are.
